name: JEPA objective suitability pilot for hidden object state
claim: At matched causal information and model capacity, embedding prediction retains action-relevant hidden-state information and offers a measurable robustness or data-efficiency benefit beyond direct physical-response prediction; decision value is a separate gated claim.
unit_of_analysis: Parent history block conditional on the fixed carrier; pair members, future branches, frames and training seeds remain dependent. Specimen/batch clustering is required for material-level claims.
datasets: D0 archived diagnostic only, with privileged construction caveats
D1 proposed qualified spatial 2D, independent noise, matched and natural histories
D2 full-arm study only after parent stage gates

splits.name: parent_training_validation_pilot_test
splits.held_out: All parent IDs and future branches grouped; independent pilot and fresh final test
splits.leakage_check: Reuse parent split contract; no selection by future effect or oracle action disagreement

splits.name: future_action_shift
splits.leakage_check: Freeze command families before final data; no future achieved motion as input

splits.name: nuisance_and_physics_shift
splits.held_out: Separately declared sensing and physical parameter/geometry conditions
splits.leakage_check: Augmentations preserve physical state and channel units; no target-field leakage

baselines.name: true state with same fitted predictor
controlled_variables: same law, action library and controller; not global optimum

metrics.name: held-out force-response error under unseen commands
metrics.rationale: Common physical output avoids comparing incompatible latent-loss scales

metrics.name: nuisance-shift degradation or data-efficiency curve
metrics.direction: lower degradation / fewer independent training units
metrics.rationale: Test the reason for using JEPA, not only more model capacity

metrics.name: older-history residual gain and recursive forecast accuracy
metrics.direction: below a meaningful frozen tolerance with accurate outputs
metrics.rationale: Test omitted information; nonsignificance and agreement between wrong forecasts are insufficient

metrics.name: proper distributional score and coverage if a belief is claimed
metrics.rationale: Point loss does not establish uncertainty adequacy

metrics.name: full-operation decision utility
metrics.rationale: Secondary gated study only after true-state headroom; include preload/probe/release/retreat

ablations: future time horizon covering calibrated modes
physical-response anchor only after a diagnosed embedding failure
all learned memory and filters serialized
falsification_criteria: Embedding accuracy does not preserve held-out physical response: reject tested target adequacy
Gain disappears when history, capacity, labels and compute are matched: reject JEPA-specific improvement
Short classical or direct prediction is adequate and JEPA has no useful robustness/data-efficiency benefit: stop escalation
No restricted true-state action headroom: stop action-benefit claim for that task
Prior work matches core problem, information and contribution: stop that novelty argument

compute_budget.full_visual_sweep: deferred pending measured need and throughput
